headline_stat.name: POST non-REM SWR events with significant replay vs cell-identity floor
headline_stat.value: 8.4% vs 5.35%, binomial p=1.9e-6 (PRE at noise floor 6.2% vs 6.2%, p=0.50)

stated_limitation: This is also a single session from one animal; the PRE/POST contrast is well controlled within the session, but the size of the effect should not be generalised from n = 1. ... reverse-going trajectories outnumber forward-going ones in every epoch, including PRE, where the content is at chance. That asymmetry is therefore a property of the analysis ... and should not be read as a biological forward/reverse bias.

justification.dataset: DANDI:000044 (Grosmark & Buzsáki CA1, rat Achilles) with its PRE/novel-MAZE/POST structure is the canonical dataset for demonstrating experience-dependent hippocampal replay.
justification.handling: Real 8.7 GB NWB streamed via remfile; spikes, linearised position, author sleep scoring, and an auto-selected pyramidal-layer LFP channel are all loaded correctly with explicit, defensible unit and epoch criteria.
justification.analysis: Bayesian decoding with a cross-validated decoder, posterior-weighted correlation, two within-event nulls, and a per-epoch cell-identity pipeline shuffle, with the best-of-two-directions maximum applied to the nulls too, is textbook-plus and correctly uses PRE as a within-session false-positive control.
justification.correctness: Every headline number (5.2 cm decoding error, 6.2%/6.2% PRE, 8.4%/5.35% POST, all p-values, 4.6 m/s speed) reproduces exactly across statistics.txt, README, and figures, rests on thousands of events, and is physically plausible.
justification.figures: Six well-labeled figures with units and sample sizes show the effect clearly; example events are selected by |weighted correlation|, which is the replay statistic itself, and the population summary carries the honest distribution.
justification.honesty: Claims are strictly proportionate: PRE is reported at exactly the noise floor and interpreted as the correct null, the forward/reverse bias is flagged as an analysis artifact, and the n=1 scope is stated plainly.
justification.verdict: A rigorous, fully reproducible, exemplarily honest replay demonstration on the gold-standard dataset that I would accept and build on.
